ck_year_end_closings_reversal.name: ck_year_end_closings_reversal
ck_year_end_closings_reversal.value:
("year_end_closings"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "year_end_closings"."reversal_entry_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("year_end_closings"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "year_end_closings"."reversal_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_sales_signs_consistent.name: ck_sales_signs_consistent
ck_sales_signs_consistent.value:
(
        "sales"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 AND "sales"."discount_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales"."tax_minor" >= 0 AND "sales"."total_minor" >= 0
      ) OR (
        "sales"."subtotal_minor" <= 0 AND "sales"."discount_minor" <= 0
        AND "sales"."tax_minor" <= 0 AND "sales"."total_minor" <= 0
      )
